name: Tsushima (Aichi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsushima city emblem in purple: a ring enclosing a stylised letter V of diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Tsushima, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 March 1957.

features.role: Tsushima city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised letter V of diagonal strokes
